notes.title: HOTFIX 0.0.3 (20/09/2025)
notes.notes:
Fixes

Room Service: fixed an issue where dirt was not counted correctly by the vacuum cleaner – cleaning progress is now tracked properly.

Quest 9 – drink machine widget: fixed a bug where the widget overlapped and prevented filling the drink machine. The widget now appears under the machine app interface. This issue only affected low-resolution monitors.

Task list – bathroom furnishing: clarified the description – added information that the toilet paper holder and towel hanger can be found in the Service section of the Motel Mart app.

Room 1 – doors: added a notification indicating that the door will unlock as the mission progresses. The previous message was unclear and could be misleading.

Notes (important for existing saves affected by the vacuum cleaner bug)

If the vacuum cleaner bug has already been saved into your current game progress, you don’t need to start over.
We’ve added a special bind that resets the faulty Room Service counter once, letting you keep your progress.

This only applies if you’ve already cleaned the entire room, but the game still shows the message saying “not everything has been cleaned”.

Step-by-step instructions

Enter the room where the bug occurs.

Press CTRL + ENTER to activate the developer console.

⚠️ WARNING: Do not use any other codes – they may damage your game or save.

The console is provided only to help fix this bug.

If the Room Service task list appears → press “5” to reset the faulty counter.

If the task list does not appear:

Press “Z” to bring it up.

Then press “5” to reset the counter.

After resetting, leave the room and re-enter to check if the task list has updated.

Book the room for a guest – it must be a fully cleaned room after a complete Room Service.

Wait until the guest checks out (tip: sleep through the number of days of their stay).

From now on, the bug should no longer appear. Perform Room Service normally.

Save your game – your save file is now clean and free of the bug.

After you will leave the game and reload your save, all will be working fine and the codes will be off.

We fight for your best experience during the day… and wrestle with bugs in our dreams at night.

Yours 
Red Phoenix Team

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #8
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋 

Hope you're all doing great. We’ve got a fresh update for Holiday Motel Simulator and wanted to give you a quick peek at what we’ve been cooking up - literally, in some cases. 😄 

Lately, we’ve been focused on making the beach area feel way more alive and… well, vacation-y. There’s also been a bunch of polish and behind-the-scenes improvements to help everything run smoother. Let’s break it down: 

[b]🍹 The Beach is Getting Busy! [/b]

We’ve finally added two big features:

[b]Beach Bar Drinks[/b] - You will be able to mix and serve drinks in the evenings. The system is fully functional (with more visual tweaks coming soon), so get ready to channel your inner beach bartender soon! 

[b]Beach Food Service[/b] – During the day, you'll be serving simple meals to hungry beachgoers.

The beach isn’t just for chilling anymore... it’s for cooking and mixing too. 😎 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/11951c5b70b86bd7de09b166910062c4bb368d44.jpg[/img]

[b]😴 Simplified Sleep System [/b]
Sleeping is a lot more straightforward now. You can choose to sleep until morning or evening, and the bed UI has been cleaned up to make it easier to use.

[b]📱 Phone UI Got a Tune-Up [/b]
We gave the in-game phone a little makeover. Menus are smoother and just feel better to use. Not a huge change, but a nice quality-of-life improvement! 

[b]🗺️ Map Tweaks & Performance Touch-Ups [/b]
We’ve made some behind-the-scenes changes to static objects on the map for better performance. Just making things run nicer overall! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/bf5771f521f3e7ab6cb9a827b0861e4a1b501fe2.jpg[/img]

[b]🎨 Visual Polish & Random Fun Stuff [/b]
✅Added more graffiti and changed up some meshes like newspapers and small props. 
✅Improved a ton of object textures. Everything looks just a bit nicer now. 
✅Even the trash bag tool got an upgrade with a more detailed model. Because hey, even garbage deserves to look good, right? 

[b]🧪 Wanna Help Us Test Soon? [/b]
We’re still deep in development - tuning systems, cleaning things up, and working on the overall feel of the game. Once everything’s a bit more stable, we’re planning to open up playtesting. 

If you’re interested in helping out, hop into our Discord and keep an eye out for test announcements! 

[url=discord.com/invite/hvZjkKe6Ue][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/ef4915beaf359b2c8f485ed21e62baff4658c46c.png[/img][/url]

Thanks as always for sticking with us! Every update gets us one step closer to making Holiday Motel Simulator the weird, chill, offbeat vacation game we’ve always imagined. 🏝️ 


Catch you soon!
RED Phoenix Interactive

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #7
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Future Motel Owners![/b]

Welcome to another update this year! We’re excited to share the progress we’ve made on our game. We’re happy to announce that we have completely finished and fully refined the room renovation mechanics! Everything is working great, and we can’t wait for you to experience it yourselves.

At the beginning, the available rooms will be in terrible condition – completely uninhabitable. One of your first tasks will be to fully renovate them. In total, you’ll have 18 rooms to restore, which will become a key source of income and allow you to further develop your motel.

🛠 Take a look inside – the first renovated room! 🛠

This is what a fully restored guest room can look like!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/c36c6b84f3fb5ff60edf55acbaefb8c8e600c674.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/7f8ec11bd3dd9efb6d6604332359dc4ea40589e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/62a4c3517d8e9410b3e9735d2afe9f4cd9c1f4b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/11cbb56b34e73d0a889907eddcf2b313f25058a8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870031/b16f73c7d8b87b40860514974bbab1fd3015256f.png[/img]
You now have access to over 600 different items for interior design! You can freely choose from a wide range of furniture, lighting, building materials, and decorations, creating unique spaces in your motel.

We hope that the customization options will inspire you and allow you to fully unleash your creativity. We can’t wait to see the amazing interiors you create! 🎨✨

🌴 What’s Next? AI Development and New Features! 🌴

We are currently focusing on developing and implementing AI for motel guests, their interactions with the environment, and how they are serviced. We are also working on new features related to the motel shop, the beach, and the beach bar located right behind it.

There will be plenty of challenges ahead – managing the motel is just the beginning! You’ll need to take care of not only your guests’ comfort but also ensure the smooth operation of the beach and the shop. One thing is certain – you won’t have time to get bored!

Additionally, after the game’s release, we plan to continuously expand and improve it based on your feedback. As we mentioned before, we’re planning to launch the game in Early Access, meaning you’ll soon have the opportunity to actively shape its development. We’re committed to making this game the best it can be – and for that, we need you, the players! 🎮💡

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to share even more updates with you soon! 🚀

[b]Best Regards
RED Pheonix Interactive[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #6
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Future Motel Owners![/b]

With the new year upon us, we warmly welcome you and thank you for the tremendous interest and support you’ve shown for our game. To kick off this year, we’d like to share some updates on the progress of our development.

We’re currently focused on rewriting most of the game’s mechanics to create more optimized code. This will ensure the game runs faster, smoother, and is better prepared for future updates. Our internal beta tests have shown that this is a crucial step in delivering the best possible experience for you.

We’re thrilled to announce that we’re introducing items to the in-game shop. At this moment, we already have over 200 unique pieces of furniture that you can place in your rooms—and this is just the beginning! We haven’t even touched on bathroom items, wall and floor finishes, or many other features. This is only a small fraction of what we’ve planned, and we’re adding more every day. All of this is designed to give you the greatest creative freedom in decorating and designing your future motels.

The code changes we’re implementing now are also aimed at allowing us to quickly respond to your feedback and adapt the game to your expectations once it enters Early Access.

While there’s still a lot of work ahead, we’re fully committed to completing it and are doing everything we can to release the game this year without any delays. Unfortunately, due to the scale of the project and our limited resources, we can’t provide you with a specific release date yet. However, we promise to keep you updated regularly on our progress.

Thank you for your patience, support, and enthusiasm—they truly drive us forward. We are a small but incredibly dedicated team—just a handful of people pouring their hearts into this project. We believe the final result will be worth the wait, and we hope it will exceed your expectations!

Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey. See you in the upcoming updates—and once again, we wish you a very Happy New Year!

[b]Best regards,
RED Phoenix Interactive[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #5
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back after a long break![/b]

Recently, we’ve put a lot of effort into introducing new mechanics and reworking the map to align it with the gameplay we have planned. Instead of just writing about it, we’ll show you a few screenshots from the game that showcase the current state of our work. Of course, a lot will still change, but this will give you an idea of what we’re planning to bring into the game.

[b]In short, you’re essentially getting three games in one from us. [/b]😊
[b]Yes, that’s right![/b]
[u]You’ll be able to serve your guests in your motel shop, on the beach, and, of course, as guests in your rooms. In addition to the fun of renovating, which will be the first stage of your gameplay, in the later stages you’ll have plenty of work to do to earn money for further renovations and upgrades to your motel!
[/u]
Our priority is to create the game in a way that makes the gameplay as relaxing and engaging as possible for you. The mechanics won’t be too complicated but will still be complex enough to provide a challenge and give you satisfaction from playing.

There won’t be any skill trees or unnecessary experience points here. Why? Because this isn’t an RPG! It’s a relaxing simulator that allows you to manage a motel in a charming tropical setting inspired by the eastern coast of the USA, but in a more intimate atmosphere. 😊

We hope you’ll enjoy the results of our work so far. As we mentioned, we’re continuously working on improving all the details of the map and mechanics, while also introducing new elements to make everything as consistent with our vision as possible and to ensure you have the most fun!

[b]Your team,
RED PHOENIX INTERACTIVE[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #4
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again![/b]

Recently, a talented programmer joined our team, prompting us to make some changes throughout the game. We are currently revising all the mechanics related to renovation and cleaning, such as:

[b]- Wall painting:[/b] We want it to be more satisfying and smooth.

[b]- Barcode scanner:[/b] Used for selling unnecessary items, it will also undergo a minor upgrade, both visually and in terms of the sales animation 😊

[b]- Crowbar:[/b] This element was the least satisfying during our internal tests, so we are making changes to both the destruction animation and the crowbar hit itself. It needs to be more "meaty"!

[b]- Vacuuming:[/b] We are working to make it look more realistic. We aim to improve animations and add particle effects.

[b]- Pressure washer:[/b] Similar to vacuuming, we want it to look more realistic – more watery!

[b]- Window cleaning:[/b] The mechanics only need minor cosmetic adjustments.

[b]- Tile laying:[/b] We are completely overhauling this mechanic to expand it slightly. We want to add wall preparation using plaster, so before laying tiles, you will need to prepare and level the wall each time.

[b]- Trash collection:[/b] We are improving animations and making it more accessible and relaxing. Though it may be hard to imagine, trash collection can also be relaxing 😊

[b]- Using a screwdriver: [/b]This mechanic will be significantly expanded since the screwdriver is our indispensable friend for minor repairs that may be needed in our motel, such as fixing air conditioners, electrical panels, lighting, etc. These won’t be complicated repairs but will give us a bit of work to ensure there is always something to do in our establishment.

[b]- Mopping the bathroom floor:[/b] We are enhancing the animation and adding particle effects to make floor cleaning more immersive. We remember that everything should still be relaxing – after all, that's our goal!

[b]- Using a sponge:[/b] Currently, it is quite unintuitive, so we want to improve it by adding better animations and effects to make it more satisfying.

Additionally, we are working on optimizing the map, lighting, textures, and revising key locations. The user interface and minor mechanics related to the shop, tablet, etc., also require modifications.

We can already reveal that the beach behind the motel, our office with the storage room, and your own shop where you can sell essential vacation items like sunscreen, sunglasses, and maybe even local souvenirs, will play a significant role in the game. Soon, once all the above mechanics are optimized and improved, we will present a gameplay video showcasing a bit of the map and the basics of renovation 😊

We are doing everything to get the game into your hands, but we want it to be a product worthy of your attention, not another poor-quality product that unfortunately floods the platforms. Thank you for your interest, and we assure you that work on our game is in full swing. Our team is growing, which, in addition to improving efficiency, also brings a breath of fresh ideas to the game, which we hope will keep you engrossed in our simulator for many hours!

[b]Best regards
Red Pheonix Interactive[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #3
notes.notes:
[b]Hello![/b]

In summarizing the progress of our work, we would like to share a few updates from the development of our game, so:

1) The room rating system is now complete.
2) We are also gradually finishing the tutorial system in the form of small quests, which will guide you through all the necessary aspects of motel renovation and management to turn you into true "moteliers" 😊. Additionally, we are working on fixing minor bugs that we noticed during internal testing and introducing NPCs into the game world to fill it with your potential customers. Remember to maintain room cleanliness and proper management of all necessary personal hygiene items, as it is well known that a lack of toilet paper or clean towels can lead to disaster!

Soon, we will try to provide more information about the release date, as we are already in the final stages. Within a few weeks, we aim to conclude the work and initial testing phase and release our game as Early Access, so that each of you can have a real impact on how the product will look. Only then will we begin an even more intense phase of work to refine our game in a way that best suits you – our players!

[u]We remain grateful for the tremendous support; our wishlist is bursting at the seams, and let's hope that this translates into the expansion of our community[/u] 😊.

[b]Best regards
Red Phoenix Interactive[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #2

After a short break, we return with a handful of new updates. First and foremost, we would like to share with you the latest news regarding the work we are currently undertaking. The most significant of these is our work on the room rating system. This mechanic will directly impact the room rental price per day, in short, determining how much you will earn from the most crucial element of the motel - renting out your renovated and appropriately decorated rooms. The system will tally and classify each room, assigning it a corresponding number of stars, which will enhance its prestige, and consequently, your profit. Contrary to appearances, this will be simple and intuitive, and you will learn more about room classification in the game itself and in the accompanying smartphone application, where you'll find a guide to assist you in managing your motel.

Additionally, taking into account the feedback we received regarding wall painting (specifically, that it was too simple and required only one click to paint an entire wall), we have decided to refine this mechanic. It is now more comprehensive and time-consuming, but we believe the end result justifies the effort. We're not taking shortcuts; we're striving to enrich every aspect of the game to ensure that the pleasure derived from playing it is maximized!

[u]Thank you for your support, and we encourage you to continue following our progress. Together, we're creating a better version of our simulator![/u]

[b]Best regards,
Red Phoenix Interactive[/b]

notes.title: GAMEDEV LOG #1
notes.notes:
[b]Dear future motel owners![/b]

We want to share with you an update regarding the progress of our first upcoming title - "Holiday Motel Simulator". Currently, we have completed about 60% of the game. However, the remaining 40% is definitely the most important, as it concerns mechanics related to continuous gameplay, which will immerse you in our game for many hours - at least that's what we hope!

We have a substantial portion of game mechanics ready, and we are currently focusing on expanding the map, enriching it with new details. Additionally, we are introducing new items to the game so that you can further personalize your motels, creating unforgettable places for relaxation and leisure.

We haven't forgotten about existing mechanics - we're continuously working on polishing them to provide you with the best gameplay experiences. We're particularly focused on the customer service mechanics, which are being created from scratch so that you can effectively manage your motel and provide guests with unforgettable vacations.

Thank you for your patience and support, our wishlist is bursting at the seams, giving us even more energy to work and create. There's still a lot to do ahead of us, as our heads are bursting with new ideas for both the motel itself and its associated gameplay.

Soon, we'll share further updates, so stay tuned to our Steam page to keep up with the progress of creating "Holiday Motel Simulator"!

[b]Best regards,
Red Phoenix Interactive[/b]
